items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I heard Hal Geordie when he was playing in a place on Canal Street.

ctx.x: Oh wait, let's see a funny thing now. I think that was his son. Hal, didn't he have a son that played something? Bob Zagerman. I don't really know. Gee whiz. I'm trying to think of somebody that used to come around the store that used to talk about him. And I thought it was...
There's very few people that would remember him now, because that's a long time ago, and he wasn't yet.
